description: When every presence request fails (simulated with a route returning 500 for /sessions and /sessions/SID/report), the browser shows nothing: the sync line still reads "Saved locally · synced", no notice appears, and the person's own avatar in their own header silently reads "Dev Patel, human, offline" while they are actively working. Teammates see Dev offline with no focus marker.
expected: A quiet, specific notice such as "Your presence isn't being shared (retrying)" near the You button, or at minimum the You button reflecting the failure.
actual: 3 failed requests in 20 s, zero UI feedback; own avatar greyed with no explanation.
suggested_fix: Surface reporter failures (other than handled expiry) as a status on the You button with a retry.

description: Idle and active differ only by a dashed versus solid ring of the same colour on a 32px avatar (card marker 24px). At a glance on the card the dashed ring reads as a rendering artefact.
expected: Idle is distinguishable at a glance (e.g. muted fill or a hollow status dot) in addition to the ring style.
actual: Dashed ring only; the status dot changes subtly.
suggested_fix: Add a second cue for idle (dimmed initials or a hollow dot).
